summary: Master Maritime Law and Insurance claims through our specialized training. Equip yourself with the knowledge to excel in this vital sector.
lede: Marine claims training helps shipping and insurance professionals assess liability, coverage and losses in shipping disputes. It develops skills in reviewing contracts and policies, building casualty chronologies and evidence matrices, and calculating cargo or hull claims. Participants also practise recovery planning and negotiation using structured claims workflows and practical analysis templates.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with shipping transactions, vessel operations, marine insurance, cargo movement, or commercial disputes and need stronger capability in maritime claims analysis.
modules: Maritime Law Foundations and Risk Allocation
Integrated Claims Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to shipping operations, marine insurance, cargo movement, vessel management, or commercial claims. No legal qualification or programming experience is required. Familiarity with bills of lading, charterparties, insurance policies, or casualty records will help you gain more from the exercises. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted claims review and Power BI dashboard design are covered at operational application level, not software engineering level.
